description: Check a purchase, renewal or refinance against the OSFI stress test: qualifying rate (higher of contract + 2% or 5.25%), GDS/TDS at 39/44, pass/close/fail, max home price for a purchase, and how far off a fail is. Straight-switch renewals are exempt unless the amount or amortization increases.

additionalBorrow.description: Refinance only: extra cash to borrow in CAD

annualIncome.description: Main applicant gross annual income in CAD

coApplicantIncome.description: Co-applicant gross annual income in CAD (0 if none)

contractRatePct.description: Contract interest rate as a percent

downPayment.description: Purchase only: down payment in CAD

homePrice.description: Purchase price, or current home value for renewal/refinance, in CAD

monthlyCondoFees.description: Monthly condo fees in CAD (50% counts)

monthlyDebtPayments.description: Other monthly debt payments in CAD

outstandingBalance.description: Renewal/refinance only: balance owing in CAD

renewalIncreasing.description: Renewal only: increasing the amount or amortization (then the stress test applies)

renewalRatePct.description: Renewal only: rate you are renewing into, percent

renewalWithNewLender.description: Renewal only: switching to a new lender

name: mortgage_stress_test
title: Canadian Mortgage Stress Test (OSFI B-20)
